name: Enterprise operations golden set
description: Reviewed retrieval, grounding, metadata, multi-source, ambiguity, and abstention cases for the local reference corpus.

documents.title: Refund Policy v3
documents.text:
# Refund Policy v3

## Window
Customers may request a refund within 30 calendar days of purchase. The previous 14 day window is retired.

## Approval
Refunds above GBP 500 require approval from the finance duty manager. Smaller refunds may be approved by a support team lead.

## Exclusions
Downloaded digital goods are not refundable after the download begins unless the content is defective.

## Processing
Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within five business days.

documents.title: Refund Policy v2
documents.text:
# Refund Policy v2

This superseded policy allowed refund requests within 14 calendar days. All refunds above GBP 250 required approval from the billing manager. This version was retired when Refund Policy v3 became effective.

documents.title: Access Control Standard
documents.text:
# Access Control Standard

## Administrators
Production administrators must use phishing-resistant MFA with a hardware security key. SMS is not accepted for privileged access.

## Reviews
The IAM team owns quarterly access reviews. Review evidence must be retained with the audit record.

## Emergency access
Emergency access grants expire after four hours and require an incident ticket.

## Departures
Access for departing staff must be disabled within one hour of the recorded departure time.

documents.title: Incident Response Handbook
documents.text:
# Incident Response Handbook

## Severity one
A severity one incident must be acknowledged within 10 minutes. The first qualified responder becomes incident commander until a handoff is recorded.

## Communications
The first customer status update is due within 30 minutes of declaration. Updates continue every 30 minutes while impact remains active.

## Evidence
Responders preserve logs, timestamps, and decision records in the incident case.

## Closure
A written review is due within five business days after resolution.

documents.title: Data Retention Schedule
documents.text:
# Data Retention Schedule

Application logs are retained for 90 days. Security audit records are retained for seven years.

Expired records are deleted by the monthly disposal job. Legal holds suspend deletion for the affected records.

The legal operations team owns the retention schedule. Data owners must document approved exceptions.

documents.title: Model Deployment Standard
documents.text:
# Model Deployment Standard

New model versions start with a 5 percent canary for at least 30 minutes. The rollout stops when the canary error rate exceeds 2 percent or a safety gate fails.

The ML platform on-call engineer owns rollback execution. Promotion to full traffic requires passing quality, latency, and safety gates.

Deployment records include model checksum, tokenizer version, runtime image, evaluation report, and approver.

documents.title: Vendor Risk Procedure
documents.text:
# Vendor Risk Procedure

Critical vendors receive a risk assessment every year. The assessment requires current SOC 2 evidence or an approved equivalent.

Procurement owns the vendor record. Security reviews technical controls, and legal reviews data processing terms.

Critical findings require a remediation plan within 30 days. Unresolved critical findings block contract renewal.

documents.title: Backup and Recovery Runbook
documents.text:
# Backup and Recovery Runbook

The production database recovery point objective is 15 minutes. The recovery time objective is two hours.

Infrastructure runs a restore test every quarter. A successful test verifies row counts, checksums, application startup, and access controls.

Backup encryption keys are stored separately from backup data. Failed backups page the infrastructure on-call engineer.

documents.title: Enterprise Support SLA
documents.text:
# Enterprise Support SLA

Priority one cases have a 15 minute initial response target. Priority two cases have a two hour initial response target.

Enterprise priority one coverage operates 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Planned maintenance announced at least seven days ahead is excluded from availability calculations.

The support duty manager owns severity disputes and customer escalation coordination.

documents.title: Privacy Request Procedure
documents.text:
# Privacy Request Procedure

Verified privacy requests are completed within 30 calendar days. Identity must be verified before personal data is disclosed or deleted.

The data protection officer owns deadline extensions. Any extension must be documented and communicated before the original deadline.

Requests and fulfillment evidence are recorded in the privacy case system.

documents.title: GPU Capacity Guide
documents.text:
# GPU Capacity Guide

The standard inference pool uses H100 GPUs with 80 GB of memory. Sustained GPU utilization above 85 percent triggers a capacity review.

Reserved benchmark capacity must be requested 72 hours in advance. The ML platform capacity manager approves reservations above eight GPUs.

Teams record model name, quantization, context length, batch settings, and expected tokens per second in each request.

documents.title: RAG Operations Standard
documents.text:
# RAG Operations Standard

Production retrieval hit rate must remain at or above 0.85. NDCG at k must remain at or above 0.75 on the approved golden set.

The answer path abstains when retrieval confidence is below 0.32 and no approved fallback supplies evidence. A change of embedding model requires a full reindex.

Release evidence includes MRR, NDCG, grounding, citation coverage, latency, cache hit rate, and GPU utilization. Evaluation regressions block promotion.
